title: Tabs
body: Each tab covers one part of a standard essay.
instruction: Use the arrow keys to move between tabs.

_items.title: The introduction
_items.body: Set up the question, say why it matters, and state the line your essay will argue.

_items.title: The body
_items.body: One idea per paragraph. Make a claim, give evidence, and explain how the evidence supports the claim.

_items.title: The conclusion
_items.body: Answer the question in light of the argument. Add nothing new; show what the essay has shown.
